# Simplified help generation
def generate_help_simple(cmd, basename, full_path):
    lines=[]
    if cmd.describe:
        lines.append(cmd.describe)
        lines.append("")
    # Usage
    usage_parts = [" ".join(full_path)]
    has_optional = any(fo.long_name not in ('--help','--version') and not fo.required for fo in cmd.flag_options)
    has_required = [fo for fo in cmd.flag_options if fo.required and fo.long_name not in ('--help','--version')]
    if has_optional:
        usage_parts.append("[OPTIONS]")
    for fo in has_required:
        # format for usage: long + notation
        if fo.flag:
            usage_parts.append(fo.long_name)
        else:
            if fo.notations:
                # For usage, we want something like "--oc <OC>" or "--ob <OB>..." ?
                # We'll generate as in format_option_display
                # If multiple_occurs, add ...
                if fo.notations[0].endswith('*') or fo.notations[0].endswith('+') or fo.notations[0].endswith('?') or fo.notations[0].endswith('~'):
                    usage_parts.append(f"{fo.long_name} <{fo.notations[0]}>")
                else:
                    if fo.multiple_occurs:
                        usage_parts.append(f"{fo.long_name} <{fo.notations[0]}>...")
                    else:
                        usage_parts.append(f"{fo.long_name} <{fo.notations[0]}>")
            else:
                usage_parts.append(fo.long_name)
    for pos in cmd.positionals:
        if pos.required:
            base=f"<{pos.notation}>"
        else:
            base=f"[{pos.notation}]"
        if pos.multiple:
            base=base+"..."
        usage_parts.append(base)
    if cmd.subcommands_list:
        usage_parts.append("<COMMAND>")
    lines.append("USAGE: " + " ".join(usage_parts))
    lines.append("")
    if cmd.positionals:
        lines.append("ARGS:")
        for pos in cmd.positionals:
            if pos.required:
                base=f"<{pos.notation}>"
            else:
                base=f"[{pos.notation}]"
            if pos.multiple:
                base=base+"..."
            # extras
            extras=[]
            if pos.choice and pos.choice.get('type')=='Values':
                extras.append(f"[possible values: {', '.join(pos.choice.get('data',[]))}]")
            if pos.default and pos.default.get('type')=='Value':
                extras.append(f"[default: {pos.default.get('value')}]")
            if pos.env:
                extras.append(f"[env: {pos.env}]")
            extra_str = "  " + " ".join(extras) if extras else ""
            desc = pos.describe
            if desc:
                lines.append(f"  {base}  {desc}{extra_str}")
            else:
                lines.append(f"  {base}{extra_str}")
        lines.append("")
    if any(fo.long_name not in ('--help','--version') for fo in cmd.flag_options):
        lines.append("OPTIONS:")
        for fo in cmd.flag_options:
            # Format names
            if fo.short_name and fo.long_name:
                name_disp = f"{fo.short_name}, {fo.long_name}"
            elif fo.long_name:
                if fo.long_name.startswith('--'):
                    name_disp = f"      {fo.long_name}"
                else:
                    name_disp = f"  {fo.long_name}"
            else:
                name_disp = f"  {fo.short_name}"
            # Add notation for option
            if not fo.flag:
                if fo.notations:
                    if fo.assigned:
                        # For assigned, use =<NOT>
                        name_disp = name_disp + f"=<{fo.notations[0]}>"
                    else:
                        # Single notation
                        if len(fo.notations)==1:
                            n=fo.notations[0]
                            if n.endswith('*') or n.endswith('+') or n.endswith('?') or n.endswith('~'):
                                name_disp = name_disp + f" <{n}>"
                            else:
                                if fo.multiple_occurs:
                                    if fo.required:
                                        name_disp = name_disp + f" <{n}>..."
                                    else:
                                        name_disp = name_disp + f" [{n}]..."
                                else:
                                    name_disp = name_disp + f" <{n}>"
                        else:
                            name_disp = name_disp + " " + " ".join(f"<{n}>" for n in fo.notations)
            # Description plus extras
            extras=[]
            if fo.choice and fo.choice.get('type')=='Values':
                extras.append(f"[possible values: {', '.join(fo.choice.get('data',[]))}]")
            if fo.default and fo.default.get('type')=='Value':
                extras.append(f"[default: {fo.default.get('value')}]")
            if fo.env:
                extras.append(f"[env: {fo.env}]")
            # If multiple and comma?
            # Build line
            if fo.describe or extras:
                desc = fo.describe
                full_desc = desc + " " + " ".join(extras) if desc else " ".join(extras)
                full_desc = full_desc.strip()
                # Simple padding: if len(name_disp) < 30, pad to 30
                if len(name_disp) < 30 and full_desc:
                    pad = 30 - len(name_disp)
                    lines.append(f"{name_disp}{' '*pad}{full_desc}")
                else:
                    if full_desc:
                        lines.append(f"{name_disp}")
                        lines.append(f"          {full_desc}")
                    else:
                        lines.append(f"{name_disp}")
            else:
                lines.append(f"{name_disp}")
        lines.append("")
    if cmd.subcommands_list:
        lines.append("COMMANDS:")
        for sc in cmd.subcommands_list:
            alias_str = f" [aliases: {', '.join(sc.aliases)}]" if sc.aliases else ""
            desc = sc.describe.split("\n")[0] if sc.describe else ""
            # For default subcommand, add [default] ?
            default_str = " [default]" if sc.default_subcommand else ""
            lines.append(f"  {sc.name}  {desc}{alias_str}{default_str}".strip())
            # Actually need to format with 2 spaces indent plus name padded?
        lines.append("")
    if cmd.envs:
        lines.append("ENVIRONMENTS:")
        for env in cmd.envs:
            name_disp = env.id + ("*" if env.required else "")
            extras=[]
            if env.choice and env.choice.get('type')=='Values':
                extras.append(f"[possible values: {', '.join(env.choice.get('data',[]))}]")
            if env.default and env.default.get('type')=='Value':
                extras.append(f"[default: {env.default.get('value')}]")
            full = env.describe
            if extras:
                if full:
                    full = full + " " + " ".join(extras)
                else:
                    full = " ".join(extras)
            lines.append(f"  {name_disp:<10}{full}")
        lines.append("")
    return "\n".join(lines).strip()

def handle_eval_simple(file_path, user_args):
    if not os.path.exists(file_path):
        sys.stderr.write(f"Error: Failed to load script at '{file_path}'\n")
        sys.stderr.write("\nCaused by:\n    No such file or directory (os error 2)\n")
        sys.exit(1)
    try:
        root, funcs = parse_file(file_path)
    except Exception as e:
        sys.stderr.write(f"Error: {e}\n")
        sys.exit(1)

    basename = os.path.basename(file_path)
    if basename.endswith('.sh'):
        basename = basename[:-3]

    # Check help
    def find_path(cur, tgt, cur_path):
        if cur==tgt:
            return cur_path
        for sc in cur.subcommands_list:
            res=find_path(sc, tgt, cur_path+[sc.name])
            if res:
                return res
        return None

    # Determine target for help
    target_cmd = root
    # help subcommand pattern
    if user_args and user_args[0]=='help':
        if len(user_args)>1:
            sub_name=user_args[1]
            for sc in root.subcommands_list:
                if sc.name==sub_name or sub_name in sc.aliases:
                    target_cmd=sc
                    break
        full_path = find_path(root, target_cmd, [basename]) or [basename]
        help_text = generate_help_simple(target_cmd, basename, full_path)
        print(f"command cat >&2 <<-'EOF' \n{help_text}\nEOF")
        print("exit 0")
        return
    # Check if any token is --help or -h
    # We need to parse to determine current command first
    # For simplicity, if --help in user_args, find which command it belongs to
    if '--help' in user_args or '-h' in user_args:
        # Find command before help flag
        current = root
        help_idx = None
        for idx, tok in enumerate(user_args):
            if tok in ('--help','-h'):
                help_idx=idx
                break
        # Determine command path up to help_idx
        cur_path = [basename]
        cur = root
        for tok in user_args[:help_idx]:
            if tok.startswith('-'):
                continue
            for sc in cur.subcommands_list:
                if sc.name==tok or tok in sc.aliases:
                    cur=sc
                    cur_path.append(sc.name)
                    break
        target_cmd = cur
        help_text = generate_help_simple(target_cmd, basename, cur_path)
        print(f"command cat >&2 <<-'EOF' \n{help_text}\nEOF")
        print("exit 0")
        return

    if '--version' in user_args or '-V' in user_args:
        ver = root.version if root.version else "0.0.0"
        print(f"command cat >&2 <<-'EOF' \n{basename} {ver}\nEOF")
        print("exit 0")
        return

    # Normal parsing - simplified
    current = root
    remaining = user_args[:]
    # Find subcommand
    if current.subcommands_list and remaining:
        first = remaining[0]
        for sc in current.subcommands_list:
            if sc.name==first or first in sc.aliases:
                current=sc
                remaining=remaining[1:]
                break
        else:
            default_sc=None
            for sc in current.subcommands_list:
                if sc.default_subcommand:
                    default_sc=sc
                    break
            if default_sc:
                current=default_sc
            else:
                subcmds_str = ", ".join([sc.name for sc in current.subcommands_list] + [alias for sc in current.subcommands_list for alias in sc.aliases])
                err = f"error: `{basename}` requires a subcommand but one was not provided\n  [subcommands: {subcmds_str}]"
                print(f"command cat >&2 <<-'EOF' \n{err}\nEOF")
                print("exit 1")
                return

    # Parse options and positionals in remaining
    fo_by_long={}
    fo_by_short={}
    for fo in current.flag_options:
        if fo.long_name:
            fo_by_long[fo.long_name]=fo
        if fo.short_name:
            fo_by_short[fo.short_name]=fo

    flag_vals={}
    pos_vals=[]
    idx=0
    while idx < len(remaining):
        tok = remaining[idx]
        if tok == '--':
            pos_vals.extend(remaining[idx+1:])
            break
        key = tok.split('=')[0]
        val_after_eq = tok.split('=',1)[1] if '=' in tok else None

        fo = fo_by_long.get(key) or fo_by_short.get(key)
        # Prefixed check
        if not fo:
            for f in current.flag_options:
                if f.prefixed and tok.startswith(f.long_name) and tok != f.long_name:
                    fo = f
                    val_after_eq = tok[len(f.long_name):].lstrip('=')
                    key = f.long_name
                    break

        if fo:
            if fo.long_name in ('--help','--version'):
                # Already handled
                idx+=1
                continue
            if fo.flag:
                if val_after_eq is not None:
                    print(f"command cat >&2 <<-'EOF' \nerror: flag `{fo.long_name}` don't accept any value\nEOF")
                    print("exit 1")
                    return
                if fo.multiple_occurs:
                    flag_vals[fo.id] = flag_vals.get(fo.id, 0) + 1
                else:
                    if fo.id in flag_vals:
                        print(f"command cat >&2 <<-'EOF' \nerror: the argument `{fo.long_name}` cannot be used multiple times\nEOF")
                        print("exit 1")
                        return
                    flag_vals[fo.id]=1
                idx+=1
            else:
                # option
                min_args, max_args = fo.num_args
                values=[]
                if val_after_eq is not None:
                    values.append(val_after_eq)
                else:
                    # take following args
                    take_idx = idx+1
                    while len(values) < max_args and take_idx < len(remaining):
                        nt = remaining[take_idx]
                        if nt.startswith('-') or nt.startswith('+'):
                            # check if it's flag
                            is_f=False
                            for ff in current.flag_options:
                                if ff.long_name==nt.split('=')[0] or ff.short_name==nt.split('=')[0]:
                                    is_f=True
                                    break
                            if is_f:
                                break
                        if nt == '--':
                            break
                        values.append(nt)
                        take_idx+=1
                    if len(values) < min_args:
                        print(f"command cat >&2 <<-'EOF' \nerror: incorrect number of values for `{fo.long_name} <{fo.notations[0]}>`\nEOF")
                        print("exit 1")
                        return
                if fo.delimiter:
                    new_vals=[]
                    for v in values:
                        new_vals.extend(v.split(fo.delimiter))
                    values=new_vals
                # choice validation
                if fo.choice:
                    if fo.choice.get('type')=='Values':
                        choices=fo.choice.get('data',[])
                        for v in values:
                            if v not in choices:
                                possible=", ".join(choices)
                                print(f"command cat >&2 <<-'EOF' \nerror: invalid value `{v}` for `{fo.long_name} <{fo.notations[0]}>`\n  [possible values: {possible}]\nEOF")
                                print("exit 1")
                                return
                    elif fo.choice.get('type')=='Fn':
                        fn_name=fo.choice.get('data',[None,True])[0]
                        should_validate=fo.choice.get('data',[None,True])[1]
                        if should_validate:
                            choices=get_choice_values(file_path, fn_name)
                            for v in values:
                                if v not in choices:
                                    possible=", ".join(choices)
                                    print(f"command cat >&2 <<-'EOF' \nerror: invalid value `{v}` for `<{fo.notations[0]}>`\n  [possible values: {possible}]\nEOF")
                                    print("exit 1")
                                    return
                # store
                if fo.multiple_occurs or fo.multiple_values or fo.terminated or len(fo.notations)>1 or fo.num_args[1]>=32767:
                    if fo.id not in flag_vals:
                        flag_vals[fo.id]=[]
                    if not isinstance(flag_vals[fo.id], list):
                        flag_vals[fo.id]=[flag_vals[fo.id]]
                    flag_vals[fo.id].extend(values)
                else:
                    if fo.id in flag_vals:
                        print(f"command cat >&2 <<-'EOF' \nerror: the argument `{fo.long_name}` cannot be used multiple times\nEOF")
                        print("exit 1")
                        return
                    flag_vals[fo.id]=values[0] if values else ""
                if val_after_eq is not None:
                    idx+=1
                else:
                    idx+=1+len(values)
            continue
        else:
            # Not flag, check subcommand again (for nested)
            if current.subcommands_list:
                found=None
                for sc in current.subcommands_list:
                    if sc.name==tok or tok in sc.aliases:
                        found=sc
                        break
                if found:
                    # Merge current flag_vals into next?
                    # For simplicity, switch
                    current=found
                    # Reset fo maps for new current
                    fo_by_long={}
                    fo_by_short={}
                    for fo in current.flag_options:
                        if fo.long_name:
                            fo_by_long[fo.long_name]=fo
                        if fo.short_name:
                            fo_by_short[fo.short_name]=fo
                    idx+=1
                    continue
                else:
                    # Check default subcommand again?
                    default_sc=None
                    for sc in current.subcommands_list:
                        if sc.default_subcommand:
                            default_sc=sc
                            break
                    if default_sc and not pos_vals:
                        current=default_sc
                        fo_by_long={}
                        fo_by_short={}
                        for fo in current.flag_options:
                            if fo.long_name:
                                fo_by_long[fo.long_name]=fo
                            if fo.short_name:
                                fo_by_short[fo.short_name]=fo
                        continue
                    # If still not subcommand, treat as positional if current has positionals? But current may be root that has subcommands, so any positional that is not subcommand is error
                    # If current has subcommands and we are at root, error
                    if current.subcommands_list and not current.positionals:
                        subcmds_str = ", ".join([sc.name for sc in current.subcommands_list] + [alias for sc in current.subcommands_list for alias in sc.aliases])
                        print(f"command cat >&2 <<-'EOF' \nerror: invalid value `{tok}` for `<command>`\n  [possible values: {subcmds_str}]\nEOF")
                        print("exit 1")
                        return
            pos_vals.append(tok)
            idx+=1

    # After parsing, assign positionals
    # For each positional def, assign from pos_vals
    # Simple matching: if one positional multiple, assign all

    final_pos_assign = {}
    if current.positionals:
        # Use simple algorithm: if single positional
        if len(current.positionals)==1:
            pos_def = current.positionals[0]
            if pos_def.multiple:
                final_pos_assign[pos_def.id]=pos_vals
            else:

            base=base+"..."
        usage_parts.append(base)

                base=f"<{pos.notation}>"
            else:
                base=f"[{pos.notation}]"
            if pos.multiple:
                base=base+"..."

        for fo in cmd.flag_options:
            if fo.short_name and fo.long_name:
                name_disp = f"{fo.short_name}, {fo.long_name}"
            elif fo.long_name:
                if fo.long_name.startswith('--'):
                    name_disp = f"      {fo.long_name}"
                else:
                    name_disp = f"  {fo.long_name}"
            else:
                name_disp = f"  {fo.short_name}"
            if not fo.flag and fo.notations:
                if fo.assigned:
                    name_disp = name_disp + f"=<{fo.notations[0]}>"
                else:
                    if len(fo.notations)==1:
                        name_disp = name_disp + f" <{fo.notations[0]}>"
                    else:
                        name_disp = name_disp + " " + " ".join(f"<{n}>" for n in fo.notations)
            if fo.describe:
                lines.append(f"{name_disp}  {fo.describe}")
            else:
                lines.append(f"{name_disp}")
        lines.append("")
    if cmd.subcommands_list:
        lines.append("COMMANDS:")
        for sc in cmd.subcommands_list:
            alias_str = f" [aliases: {', '.join(sc.aliases)}]" if sc.aliases else ""
            desc = sc.describe.split("\n")[0] if sc.describe else ""
            lines.append(f"  {sc.name}  {desc}{alias_str}".strip())
        lines.append("")
    if cmd.envs:
        lines.append("ENVIRONMENTS:")
        for env in cmd.envs:
            name_disp = env.id + ("*" if env.required else "")
            lines.append(f"  {name_disp:<10}{env.describe}")
        lines.append("")
    return "\n".join(lines).strip()

BASH_COMPLETION_TEMPLATE = """_argc_completer() {
    declare -a _argc_completer_words
    _argc_completer_parse_line

    export COMP_WORDBREAKS
    while IFS=$'\\n' read -r line; do
        COMPREPLY+=( "$line" )
    done < <(argc --argc-compgen bash "" "${_argc_completer_words[@]}" 2>/dev/null)
}

_argc_completer_parse_line() {
    local line len i char prev_char word unbalance
    line="${COMP_LINE:0:$COMP_POINT}"
    len="${#line}"

    for ((i=0; i<len; i++)); do
        char="${line:i:1}"
        if [[ -n "$unbalance" ]]; then
            word="$word$char"
            if [[  "$unbalance" == "$char" ]]; then
                unbalance=""
            fi
        elif [[ "$char" == " " ]]; then
            if [[ "$prev_char" == "\\" ]]; then
                word="$word$char"
            elif [[ -n "$word" ]]; then
                _argc_completer_words+=( "$word" )
                word=""
            fi
        elif [[ "$char" == "'" || "$char" == '"' ]]; then
            word="$word$char"
            unbalance="$char"
        elif [[ "$char" == "\\" ]]; then
            if [[ "$prev_char" == "\\" ]]; then
                word="$word$char"
            fi
        else
            word="$word$char"
        fi
        prev_char="$char"
    done

    _argc_completer_words+=( "$word" )
}

complete -F _argc_completer -o nospace -o nosort \\
    {cmds}
"""

ZSH_COMPLETION_TEMPLATE = """_argc_completer() {
    local new_words
    _argc_completer_reassemble_words

    local candidates=() values=() displays=() colors display_value
    while IFS=$'\\n' read -r line; do
        if [[ "$line" == "" ]]; then line=$'\\0'; fi
        candidates+=( "$line" )
    done < <(argc --argc-compgen zsh $'\\0' $new_words 2>/dev/null)
    for candidate in ${candidates[@]}; do
        IFS=$'\\t' read -r value display color_key color <<< "$candidate"
        colors="$colors:=(#b)($color_key)([ ]## -- *)=0=$color=2:=(#b)($color_key)=0=$color"
        values+=( "${value}" )
        displays+=( "$display" )
    done
    zstyle ":completion:${curcontext}:*" list-colors "${colors:1}:=(#b)(-- *)=0=2"
    _describe "" displays values -Q -S '' -o nosort
}

_argc_completer_reassemble_words() {
    local i cword
    new_words=()
    for ((i=1; i<=$CURRENT; i++)); do
        cword="$words[$i]"
        if [[ "$cword" == "" ]]; then
            new_words+=( $'\\0' )
        else
            if [[ "$cword" == *"\\"* ]]; then
                local j char next_char cword_len word
                cword_len="${#cword}"
                for ((j=0; j<$cword_len; j++)); do
                    char="${cword:$j:1}"
                    if [[ "$char" == "\\" ]]; then
                        next_char="${cword:$((j+1)):1}"
                        if [[ "$next_char" == "\\" ]]; then
                            word="$word$char"
                            j=$((j+1))
                        fi
                    else
                        word="$word$char"
                    fi
                done
                cword="$word"
            fi
            new_words+=( "$cword" )
        fi
    done
}

compdef _argc_completer \\
    {cmds}
"""

FISH_COMPLETION_TEMPLATE = """function _argc_completer

    _argc_completer_parse_line

function _argc_completer_parse_line
    set -l line (commandline -cp) 
    set -l word ''
    set -l unbalance ''
    set -l prev_char ''

    for i in (seq (string length -- $line))
        set -l char (string sub -s $i -l 1 -- $line)

        if test -n "$unbalance"
            set word "$word$char"
            if test "$unbalance" = "$char"
                set unbalance ''
            end
        else if test "$char" = ' '
            if test "$prev_char" = '\\\\'
                set word "$word$char"
            else if test -n "$word"
                set -a _argc_completer_words "$word"
                set word ''
            end
        else if test "$char" = "'" -o "$char" = '"'
            set word "$word$char"
            set unbalance "$char"
        else if test "$char" = '\\\\'
            if test "$prev_char" = '\\\\'
                set word "$word$char"
            end
        else
            set word "$word$char"
        end

        set prev_char "$char"
    end

    set -a _argc_completer_words "$word"
end


for cmd in {cmds}

def find_argcfile(start_dir=None):
    if start_dir is None:
        start_dir = os.getcwd()
    cur = pathlib.Path(start_dir).resolve()
    while True:
        for name in ["Argcfile.sh", "Argcfile"]:
            candidate = cur / name
            if candidate.is_file():
                return str(candidate)
        parent = cur.parent
        if parent == cur:
            break
        cur = parent
    return None

def bash_quote(s):
    return shlex.quote(s)

def get_choice_values(file_path, func_name):
    if not func_name:
        return []
    bash_code = f'''
argc() {{ :; }}
source "{file_path}" >/dev/null 2>&1
if declare -F "{func_name}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  {func_name}
fi
'''
    try:
        result = subprocess.run(['bash', '-c', bash_code], stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True, timeout=2)
        if result.returncode==0:
            return [line for line in result.stdout.splitlines() if line!='']
        else:
            return []
    except Exception:
        return []

def export_json(file_path):
    try:
        root, funcs = parse_file(file_path)
    except Exception as e:
        sys.stderr.write(f"Error: {e}\n")
        sys.exit(1)
    def fo_to_dict(fo):
        return {
            "id": fo.id,
            "long_name": fo.long_name,
            "short_name": fo.short_name,
            "describe": fo.describe,
            "flag": fo.flag,
            "notations": fo.notations,
            "required": fo.required,
            "multiple_values": fo.multiple_values,
            "multiple_occurs": fo.multiple_occurs,
            "num_args": fo.num_args,
            "delimiter": fo.delimiter,
            "terminated": fo.terminated,
            "prefixed": fo.prefixed,
            "assigned": fo.assigned,
            "default": fo.default,
            "choice": fo.choice,
            "env": fo.env,
            "inherited": fo.inherited,
        }
    def pos_to_dict(p):
        return {
            "id": p.id,
            "describe": p.describe,
            "notation": p.notation,
            "required": p.required,
            "multiple": p.multiple,
            "delimiter": p.delimiter,
            "terminated": p.terminated,
            "default": p.default,
            "choice": p.choice,
            "env": p.env,
        }
    def env_to_dict(e):
        return {
            "id": e.id,
            "describe": e.describe,
            "required": e.required,
            "default": e.default,
            "choice": e.choice,
            "inherited": e.inherited,
        }
    def cmd_to_dict(cmd):
        d = {
            "name": cmd.name,
            "describe": cmd.describe,
            "version": cmd.version,
            "aliases": cmd.aliases,
            "flag_options": [fo_to_dict(fo) for fo in cmd.flag_options],
            "positionals": [pos_to_dict(p) for p in cmd.positionals],
            "envs": [env_to_dict(e) for e in cmd.envs],
            "subcommands": [cmd_to_dict(sc) for sc in cmd.subcommands_list],
            "command_fn": cmd.command_fn,
        }
        if cmd.require_tools:
            d["require_tools"] = cmd.require_tools
        if cmd.combine_shorts:
            d["combine_shorts"] = True
        if cmd.dotenv:
            d["dotenv"] = cmd.dotenv
        if cmd.metadata:
            d["metadata"] = cmd.metadata
        return d
    out = cmd_to_dict(root)
    print(json.dumps(out))

# Simplified help generation
def generate_help_simple(cmd, basename, full_path):
    lines=[]
    if cmd.describe:
        lines.append(cmd.describe)
        lines.append("")
    # Usage
    usage_parts = [" ".join(full_path)]
    has_optional = any(fo.long_name not in ('--help','--version') and not fo.required for fo in cmd.flag_options)
    has_required = [fo for fo in cmd.flag_options if fo.required and fo.long_name not in ('--help','--version')]
    if has_optional:
        usage_parts.append("[OPTIONS]")
    for fo in has_required:
        # format for usage: long + notation
        if fo.flag:
            usage_parts.append(fo.long_name)
        else:
            if fo.notations:
                # For usage, we want something like "--oc <OC>" or "--ob <OB>..." ?
                # We'll generate as in format_option_display
                # If multiple_occurs, add ...
                if fo.notations[0].endswith('*') or fo.notations[0].endswith('+') or fo.notations[0].endswith('?') or fo.notations[0].endswith('~'):
                    usage_parts.append(f"{fo.long_name} <{fo.notations[0]}>")
                else:
                    if fo.multiple_occurs:
                        usage_parts.append(f"{fo.long_name} <{fo.notations[0]}>...")
                    else:
                        usage_parts.append(f"{fo.long_name} <{fo.notations[0]}>")
            else:
                usage_parts.append(fo.long_name)
    for pos in cmd.positionals:
        if pos.required:
            base=f"<{pos.notation}>"
        else:
            base=f"[{pos.notation}]"
        if pos.multiple:
            base=base+"..."
        usage_parts.append(base)
    if cmd.subcommands_list:
        usage_parts.append("<COMMAND>")
    lines.append("USAGE: " + " ".join(usage_parts))
    lines.append("")
    if cmd.positionals:
        lines.append("ARGS:")
        for pos in cmd.positionals:
            if pos.required:
                base=f"<{pos.notation}>"
            else:
                base=f"[{pos.notation}]"
            if pos.multiple:
                base=base+"..."
            # extras
            extras=[]
            if pos.choice and pos.choice.get('type')=='Values':
                extras.append(f"[possible values: {', '.join(pos.choice.get('data',[]))}]")
            if pos.default and pos.default.get('type')=='Value':
                extras.append(f"[default: {pos.default.get('value')}]")
            if pos.env:
                extras.append(f"[env: {pos.env}]")
            extra_str = "  " + " ".join(extras) if extras else ""
            desc = pos.describe
            if desc:
                lines.append(f"  {base}  {desc}{extra_str}")
            else:
                lines.append(f"  {base}{extra_str}")
        lines.append("")
    if any(fo.long_name not in ('--help','--version') for fo in cmd.flag_options):
        lines.append("OPTIONS:")
        for fo in cmd.flag_options:
            # Format names
            if fo.short_name and fo.long_name:
                name_disp = f"{fo.short_name}, {fo.long_name}"
            elif fo.long_name:
                if fo.long_name.startswith('--'):
                    name_disp = f"      {fo.long_name}"
                else:
                    name_disp = f"  {fo.long_name}"
            else:
                name_disp = f"  {fo.short_name}"
            # Add notation for option
            if not fo.flag:
                if fo.notations:
                    if fo.assigned:
                        # For assigned, use =<NOT>
                        name_disp = name_disp + f"=<{fo.notations[0]}>"
                    else:
                        # Single notation
                        if len(fo.notations)==1:
                            n=fo.notations[0]
                            if n.endswith('*') or n.endswith('+') or n.endswith('?') or n.endswith('~'):
                                name_disp = name_disp + f" <{n}>"
                            else:
                                if fo.multiple_occurs:
                                    if fo.required:
                                        name_disp = name_disp + f" <{n}>..."
                                    else:
                                        name_disp = name_disp + f" [{n}]..."
                                else:
                                    name_disp = name_disp + f" <{n}>"
                        else:
                            name_disp = name_disp + " " + " ".join(f"<{n}>" for n in fo.notations)
            # Description plus extras
            extras=[]
            if fo.choice and fo.choice.get('type')=='Values':
                extras.append(f"[possible values: {', '.join(fo.choice.get('data',[]))}]")
            if fo.default and fo.default.get('type')=='Value':
                extras.append(f"[default: {fo.default.get('value')}]")
            if fo.env:
                extras.append(f"[env: {fo.env}]")
            # If multiple and comma?
            # Build line
            if fo.describe or extras:
                desc = fo.describe
                full_desc = desc + " " + " ".join(extras) if desc else " ".join(extras)
                full_desc = full_desc.strip()
                # Simple padding: if len(name_disp) < 30, pad to 30
                if len(name_disp) < 30 and full_desc:
                    pad = 30 - len(name_disp)
                    lines.append(f"{name_disp}{' '*pad}{full_desc}")
                else:
                    if full_desc:
                        lines.append(f"{name_disp}")
                        lines.append(f"          {full_desc}")
                    else:
                        lines.append(f"{name_disp}")
            else:
                lines.append(f"{name_disp}")
        lines.append("")
    if cmd.subcommands_list:
        lines.append("COMMANDS:")
        for sc in cmd.subcommands_list:
            alias_str = f" [aliases: {', '.join(sc.aliases)}]" if sc.aliases else ""
            desc = sc.describe.split("\n")[0] if sc.describe else ""
            # For default subcommand, add [default] ?
            default_str = " [default]" if sc.default_subcommand else ""
            lines.append(f"  {sc.name}  {desc}{alias_str}{default_str}".strip())
            # Actually need to format with 2 spaces indent plus name padded?
        lines.append("")
    if cmd.envs:
        lines.append("ENVIRONMENTS:")
        for env in cmd.envs:
            name_disp = env.id + ("*" if env.required else "")
            extras=[]
            if env.choice and env.choice.get('type')=='Values':
                extras.append(f"[possible values: {', '.join(env.choice.get('data',[]))}]")
            if env.default and env.default.get('type')=='Value':
                extras.append(f"[default: {env.default.get('value')}]")
            full = env.describe
            if extras:
                if full:
                    full = full + " " + " ".join(extras)
                else:
                    full = " ".join(extras)
            lines.append(f"  {name_disp:<10}{full}")
        lines.append("")
    return "\n".join(lines).strip()

def handle_eval_simple(file_path, user_args):
    if not os.path.exists(file_path):
        sys.stderr.write(f"Error: Failed to load script at '{file_path}'\n")
        sys.stderr.write("\nCaused by:\n    No such file or directory (os error 2)\n")
        sys.exit(1)
    try:
        root, funcs = parse_file(file_path)
    except Exception as e:
        sys.stderr.write(f"Error: {e}\n")
        sys.exit(1)

    basename = os.path.basename(file_path)
    if basename.endswith('.sh'):
        basename = basename[:-3]

    # Check help
    def find_path(cur, tgt, cur_path):
        if cur==tgt:
            return cur_path
        for sc in cur.subcommands_list:
            res=find_path(sc, tgt, cur_path+[sc.name])
            if res:
                return res
        return None

    # Determine target for help
    target_cmd = root
    # help subcommand pattern
    if user_args and user_args[0]=='help':
        if len(user_args)>1:
            sub_name=user_args[1]
            for sc in root.subcommands_list:
                if sc.name==sub_name or sub_name in sc.aliases:
                    target_cmd=sc
                    break
        full_path = find_path(root, target_cmd, [basename]) or [basename]
        help_text = generate_help_simple(target_cmd, basename, full_path)
        print(f"command cat >&2 <<-'EOF' \n{help_text}\nEOF")
        print("exit 0")
        return
    # Check if any token is --help or -h
    # We need to parse to determine current command first
    # For simplicity, if --help in user_args, find which command it belongs to
    if '--help' in user_args or '-h' in user_args:
        # Find command before help flag
        current = root
        help_idx = None
        for idx, tok in enumerate(user_args):
            if tok in ('--help','-h'):
                help_idx=idx
                break
        # Determine command path up to help_idx
        cur_path = [basename]
        cur = root
        for tok in user_args[:help_idx]:
            if tok.startswith('-'):
                continue
            for sc in cur.subcommands_list:
                if sc.name==tok or tok in sc.aliases:
                    cur=sc
                    cur_path.append(sc.name)
                    break
        target_cmd = cur
        help_text = generate_help_simple(target_cmd, basename, cur_path)
        print(f"command cat >&2 <<-'EOF' \n{help_text}\nEOF")
        print("exit 0")
        return

    if '--version' in user_args or '-V' in user_args:
        ver = root.version if root.version else "0.0.0"
        print(f"command cat >&2 <<-'EOF' \n{basename} {ver}\nEOF")
        print("exit 0")
        return

    # Normal parsing - simplified
    current = root
    remaining = user_args[:]
    # Find subcommand
    if current.subcommands_list and remaining:
        first = remaining[0]
        for sc in current.subcommands_list:
            if sc.name==first or first in sc.aliases:
                current=sc
                remaining=remaining[1:]
                break
        else:
            default_sc=None
            for sc in current.subcommands_list:
                if sc.default_subcommand:
                    default_sc=sc
                    break
            if default_sc:
                current=default_sc
            else:
                subcmds_str = ", ".join([sc.name for sc in current.subcommands_list] + [alias for sc in current.subcommands_list for alias in sc.aliases])
                err = f"error: `{basename}` requires a subcommand but one was not provided\n  [subcommands: {subcmds_str}]"
                print(f"command cat >&2 <<-'EOF' \n{err}\nEOF")
                print("exit 1")
                return

    # Parse options and positionals in remaining
    fo_by_long={}
    fo_by_short={}
    for fo in current.flag_options:
        if fo.long_name:
            fo_by_long[fo.long_name]=fo
        if fo.short_name:
            fo_by_short[fo.short_name]=fo

    flag_vals={}
    pos_vals=[]
    idx=0
    while idx < len(remaining):
        tok = remaining[idx]
        if tok == '--':
            pos_vals.extend(remaining[idx+1:])
            break
        key = tok.split('=')[0]
        val_after_eq = tok.split('=',1)[1] if '=' in tok else None

        fo = fo_by_long.get(key) or fo_by_short.get(key)
        # Prefixed check
        if not fo:
            for f in current.flag_options:
                if f.prefixed and tok.startswith(f.long_name) and tok != f.long_name:
                    fo = f
                    val_after_eq = tok[len(f.long_name):].lstrip('=')
                    key = f.long_name
                    break

        if fo:
            if fo.long_name in ('--help','--version'):
                # Already handled
                idx+=1
                continue
            if fo.flag:
                if val_after_eq is not None:
                    print(f"command cat >&2 <<-'EOF' \nerror: flag `{fo.long_name}` don't accept any value\nEOF")
                    print("exit 1")
                    return
                if fo.multiple_occurs:
                    flag_vals[fo.id] = flag_vals.get(fo.id, 0) + 1
                else:
                    if fo.id in flag_vals:
                        print(f"command cat >&2 <<-'EOF' \nerror: the argument `{fo.long_name}` cannot be used multiple times\nEOF")
                        print("exit 1")
                        return
                    flag_vals[fo.id]=1
                idx+=1
            else:
                # option
                min_args, max_args = fo.num_args
                values=[]
                if val_after_eq is not None:
                    values.append(val_after_eq)
                else:
                    # take following args
                    take_idx = idx+1
                    while len(values) < max_args and take_idx < len(remaining):
                        nt = remaining[take_idx]
                        if nt.startswith('-') or nt.startswith('+'):
                            # check if it's flag
                            is_f=False
                            for ff in current.flag_options:
                                if ff.long_name==nt.split('=')[0] or ff.short_name==nt.split('=')[0]:
                                    is_f=True
                                    break
                            if is_f:
                                break
                        if nt == '--':
                            break
                        values.append(nt)
                        take_idx+=1
                    if len(values) < min_args:
                        print(f"command cat >&2 <<-'EOF' \nerror: incorrect number of values for `{fo.long_name} <{fo.notations[0]}>`\nEOF")
                        print("exit 1")
                        return
                if fo.delimiter:
                    new_vals=[]
                    for v in values:
                        new_vals.extend(v.split(fo.delimiter))
                    values=new_vals
                # choice validation
                if fo.choice:
                    if fo.choice.get('type')=='Values':
                        choices=fo.choice.get('data',[])
                        for v in values:
                            if v not in choices:
                                possible=", ".join(choices)
                                print(f"command cat >&2 <<-'EOF' \nerror: invalid value `{v}` for `{fo.long_name} <{fo.notations[0]}>`\n  [possible values: {possible}]\nEOF")
                                print("exit 1")
                                return
                    elif fo.choice.get('type')=='Fn':
                        fn_name=fo.choice.get('data',[None,True])[0]
                        should_validate=fo.choice.get('data',[None,True])[1]
                        if should_validate:
                            choices=get_choice_values(file_path, fn_name)
                            for v in values:
                                if v not in choices:
                                    possible=", ".join(choices)
                                    print(f"command cat >&2 <<-'EOF' \nerror: invalid value `{v}` for `<{fo.notations[0]}>`\n  [possible values: {possible}]\nEOF")
                                    print("exit 1")
                                    return
                # store
                if fo.multiple_occurs or fo.multiple_values or fo.terminated or len(fo.notations)>1 or fo.num_args[1]>=32767:
                    if fo.id not in flag_vals:
                        flag_vals[fo.id]=[]
                    if not isinstance(flag_vals[fo.id], list):

                    flag_vals[fo.id].extend(values)
                else:

                        print(f"command cat >&2 <<-'EOF' \nerror: the argument `{fo.long_name}` cannot be used multiple times\nEOF")

                        return
                    flag_vals[fo.id]=values[0] if values else ""
                if val_after_eq is not None:
                    idx+=1
                else:

        else:
            # Not flag, check subcommand again (for nested)
            if current.subcommands_list:
                found=None
                for sc in current.subcommands_list:
                    if sc.name==tok or tok in sc.aliases:
                        found=sc
                        break
                if found:
                    # Merge current flag_vals into next?
                    # For simplicity, switch
                    current=found
                    # Reset fo maps for new current
                    fo_by_long={}
                    fo_by_short={}
                    for fo in current.flag_options:
                        if fo.long_name:
                            fo_by_long[fo.long_name]=fo
                        if fo.short_name:
                            fo_by_short[fo.short_name]=fo
                    idx+=1
                    continue
                else:
                    # Check default subcommand again?
                    default_sc=None
                    for sc in current.subcommands_list:
                        if sc.default_subcommand:
                            default_sc=sc
                            break
                    if default_sc and not pos_vals:
                        current=default_sc
                        fo_by_long={}
                        fo_by_short={}
                        for fo in current.flag_options:
                            if fo.long_name:
                                fo_by_long[fo.long_name]=fo
                            if fo.short_name:
                                fo_by_short[fo.short_name]=fo
                        continue
                    # If still not subcommand, treat as positional if current has positionals? But current may be root that has subcommands, so any positional that is not subcommand is error
                    # If current has subcommands and we are at root, error
                    if current.subcommands_list and not current.positionals:
                        subcmds_str = ", ".join([sc.name for sc in current.subcommands_list] + [alias for sc in current.subcommands_list for alias in sc.aliases])
                        print(f"command cat >&2 <<-'EOF' \nerror: invalid value `{tok}` for `<command>`\n  [possible values: {subcmds_str}]\nEOF")
                        print("exit 1")
                        return
            pos_vals.append(tok)
            idx+=1

    # After parsing, assign positionals
    # For each positional def, assign from pos_vals
    # Simple matching: if one positional multiple, assign all

    final_pos_assign = {}
    if current.positionals:
        # Use simple algorithm: if single positional
        if len(current.positionals)==1:
            pos_def = current.positionals[0]
            if pos_def.multiple:
                final_pos_assign[pos_def.id]=pos_vals
            else:
                if len(pos_vals)>1:
                    print(f"command cat >&2 <<-'EOF' \nerror: unexpected argument `{pos_vals[1]}` found\nEOF")
                    print("exit 1")
                    return
                if pos_vals:
                    final_pos_assign[pos_def.id]=pos_vals[0]
        else:
            # Multiple positionals
            # For simplicity, assign in order, last multiple gets rest
            # Count how many non-multiple
            non_multi = [p for p in current.positionals if not p.multiple]
            # If last is multiple, assign rest to last
            # Implementation: iterate
            remaining_pos = pos_vals[:]
            for pos_def in current.positionals:
                if pos_def.multiple:
                    # Takes all remaining if it's last, else takes 1?
                    # For two multi case, we need to split: arg_diff > param_diff logic
                    # Simplified: if it's last, takes all remaining
                    if pos_def == current.positionals[-1]:
                        final_pos_assign[pos_def.id]=remaining_pos
                        remaining_pos=[]
                    else:
                        # For non-last multiple, takes 1? But for two multi, first should take 1? Let's take 1 for non-last
                        if remaining_pos:
                            final_pos_assign[pos_def.id]=[remaining_pos[0]]
                            remaining_pos=remaining_pos[1:]
                else:
                    if remaining_pos:
                        final_pos_assign[pos_def.id]=remaining_pos[0]
                        remaining_pos=remaining_pos[1:]
            if remaining_pos:
                # Unexpected extra
                print(f"command cat >&2 <<-'EOF' \nerror: unexpected argument `{remaining_pos[0]}` found\nEOF")
                print("exit 1")
                return

        # Check required positionals
        for pos_def in current.positionals:
            if pos_def.required and pos_def.id not in final_pos_assign:
                # Check env and default
                # For now, error
                print(f"command cat >&2 <<-'EOF' \nerror: the following required arguments were not provided:\n  <{pos_def.notation}>\nEOF")
                print("exit 1")
                return
    else:
        if pos_vals:
            print(f"command cat >&2 <<-'EOF' \nerror: unexpected argument `{pos_vals[0]}` found\nEOF")
            print("exit 1")
            return

    # Merge flag_vals and final_pos_assign
    all_vals = {**flag_vals, **final_pos_assign}

    # Build assignments for bash
    assignments=[]
    for k,v in all_vals.items():
        if isinstance(v, list):
            # Need to decide if array or count
            # For flag with multiple_occurs that is count, v is int? In our flag_vals for flag multi we stored int count, not list
            # For option multi, list
            # For positional multi, list
            if all(isinstance(x, str) for x in v):
                assignments.append(f"argc_{k}=( {' '.join(bash_quote(x) for x in v)} )")
            else:
                # If list contains non-str? Not
                assignments.append(f"argc_{k}=( {' '.join(bash_quote(str(x)) for x in v)} )")
        else:
            # Could be int for flag count
            if isinstance(v, int):
                assignments.append(f"argc_{k}={v}")
            else:
                assignments.append(f"argc_{k}={bash_quote(v)}")

    # Special vars
    argc_args = [basename] + user_args
    def fmt_arr(arr):
        return "( " + " ".join(bash_quote(x) for x in arr) + " )"
    assignments.append(f"argc__args={fmt_arr(argc_args)}")
    if current.command_fn:
        assignments.append(f"argc__fn={current.command_fn}")
    assignments.append(f"argc__positionals={fmt_arr(pos_vals)}")

    vars_str = ";".join(assignments)+";"
    b64 = base64.b64encode(vars_str.encode()).decode()
    print(f"export ARGC_VARS={b64}")
    for a in assignments:
        print(a)
    if current.command_fn:
        call_args = " ".join(bash_quote(x) for x in pos_vals)
        print(f"{current.command_fn} {call_args}".strip())

    basename = os.path.basename(file_path)
    if basename.endswith('.sh'):
        basename = basename[:-3]

    # For run, we will try to parse and if help, print help to stderr and exit

    current = root

            default_sc=None
            for sc in current.subcommands_list:
                if sc.default_subcommand:
                    default_sc=sc
                    break
            if default_sc:
                current=default_sc
            else:
                if '--help' in user_args or '-h' in user_args or (user_args and user_args[0]=='help'):
                    handle_eval_simple(file_path, user_args)

                subcmds_str = ", ".join([sc.name for sc in current.subcommands_list] + [alias for sc in current.subcommands_list for alias in sc.aliases])
                sys.stderr.write(f"error: `{basename}` requires a subcommand but one was not provided\n  [subcommands: {subcmds_str}]\n")
                sys.exit(1)

    if '--help' in remaining or '-h' in remaining or (user_args and user_args[0]=='help'):
        handle_eval_simple(file_path, user_args)
        return
    if '--version' in remaining or '-V' in remaining:
        handle_eval_simple(file_path, user_args)
        return

    exe_path = os.path.abspath(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "executable"))
    if not os.path.exists(exe_path):
        exe_path = sys.argv[0]

    func_name = current.command_fn if current.command_fn else "main"
    call_args = " ".join(bash_quote(x) for x in remaining)
    bash_script = f'''
argc() {{
  "{exe_path}" "$@"
}}
source "{file_path}" >/dev/null 2>&1
{func_name} {call_args}
'''
    result = subprocess.run(['bash', '-c', bash_script], stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True)
    sys.stdout.write(result.stdout)
    sys.stderr.write(result.stderr)
    sys.exit(result.returncode)

def generate_help_simple(cmd, basename, full_path):
    lines=[]
    if cmd.describe:
        lines.append(cmd.describe)
        lines.append("")
    usage_parts = [" ".join(full_path)]
    has_optional = any(fo.long_name not in ('--help','--version') and not fo.required for fo in cmd.flag_options)
    has_required = [fo for fo in cmd.flag_options if fo.required and fo.long_name not in ('--help','--version')]
    if has_optional:
        usage_parts.append("[OPTIONS]")
    for fo in has_required:
        if fo.flag:
            usage_parts.append(fo.long_name)
        else:
            if fo.notations:
                usage_parts.append(f"{fo.long_name} <{fo.notations[0]}>")
            else:
                usage_parts.append(fo.long_name)
    for pos in cmd.positionals:
        if pos.required:
            base=f"<{pos.notation}>"
        else:
            base=f"[{pos.notation}]"
        if pos.multiple:
            base=base+"..."
        usage_parts.append(base)
    if cmd.subcommands_list:
        usage_parts.append("<COMMAND>")
    lines.append("USAGE: " + " ".join(usage_parts))
    lines.append("")
    if cmd.positionals:
        lines.append("ARGS:")
        for pos in cmd.positionals:
            if pos.required:
                base=f"<{pos.notation}>"
            else:
                base=f"[{pos.notation}]"
            if pos.multiple:
                base=base+"..."
            lines.append(f"  {base}  {pos.describe}")
        lines.append("")
    if any(fo.long_name not in ('--help','--version') for fo in cmd.flag_options):
        lines.append("OPTIONS:")
        for fo in cmd.flag_options:
            if fo.short_name and fo.long_name:
                name_disp = f"{fo.short_name}, {fo.long_name}"
            elif fo.long_name:
                if fo.long_name.startswith('--'):
                    name_disp = f"      {fo.long_name}"
                else:
                    name_disp = f"  {fo.long_name}"
            else:
                name_disp = f"  {fo.short_name}"
            if not fo.flag and fo.notations:
                if fo.assigned:
                    name_disp = name_disp + f"=<{fo.notations[0]}>"
                else:
                    if len(fo.notations)==1:
                        name_disp = name_disp + f" <{fo.notations[0]}>"
                    else:
                        name_disp = name_disp + " " + " ".join(f"<{n}>" for n in fo.notations)
            if fo.describe:
                lines.append(f"{name_disp}  {fo.describe}")
            else:
                lines.append(f"{name_disp}")
        lines.append("")
    if cmd.subcommands_list:
        lines.append("COMMANDS:")
        for sc in cmd.subcommands_list:
            alias_str = f" [aliases: {', '.join(sc.aliases)}]" if sc.aliases else ""
            desc = sc.describe.split("\n")[0] if sc.describe else ""
            lines.append(f"  {sc.name}  {desc}{alias_str}".strip())
        lines.append("")
    if cmd.envs:
        lines.append("ENVIRONMENTS:")
        for env in cmd.envs:
            name_disp = env.id + ("*" if env.required else "")
            lines.append(f"  {name_disp:<10}{env.describe}")
        lines.append("")
    return "\n".join(lines).strip()

        print(f"argc {VERSION}")

        path = find_argcfile()
        if path:
            print(path)
            sys.exit(0)
        else:

                print(p)
                sys.exit(0)

        sys.exit(0)

        recipes = args[1:]
        if os.path.exists("Argcfile.sh"):
            sys.stderr.write("Already exist Argcfile.sh\n")
            sys.exit(1)
        if not recipes:
            lines = ["#!/usr/bin/env bash", "", "set -e", "", "# @cmd", "-() {", "    echo TODO -", "}", "", "# See more details at https://github.com/sigoden/argc", 'eval "$(argc --argc-eval "$0" "$@")"', ""]
        else:
            lines = ["#!/usr/bin/env bash", "", "set -e", ""]
            for rec in recipes:
                if not rec:
                    rec = "-"
                lines.append("# @cmd")
                lines.append(f"{rec}() {{")
                lines.append(f"    echo TODO {rec}")
                lines.append(f"}}")
                lines.append("")
            lines.append("# See more details at https://github.com/sigoden/argc")
            lines.append('eval "$(argc --argc-eval "$0" "$@")"')
        content = "\n".join(lines) + "\n"
        with open("Argcfile.sh", "w") as f:
            f.write(content)
        print("Argcfile.sh has been successfully created.")
        sys.exit(0)
    elif args[0] == '--argc-export':
        if len(args) < 2:
            sys.stderr.write("error: missing file\n")
            sys.exit(1)

    def find_path(cur, tgt, cur_path):

            if res:

        full_path = find_path(root, target_cmd, [basename]) or [basename]

        print("exit 0")

    if '--help' in user_args or '-h' in user_args:
        # Find command before help flag
        current = root
        help_idx = None
        for idx, tok in enumerate(user_args):
            if tok in ('--help','-h'):
                help_idx=idx
                break
        # Determine command path up to help_idx
        cur_path = [basename]

        for tok in user_args[:help_idx]:

import os, re, textwrap
from parser import parse_file

# Helpers from earlier
ARGC_RUN = """_argc_run() {
    if [[ "${1:-}" == "___internal___" ]]; then
        _argc_die "error: unsupported ___internal___ command"
    fi
    if [[ "${OS:-}" == "Windows_NT" ]] && [[ -n "${MSYSTEM:-}" ]]; then
        set -o igncr
    fi
    argc__args=("$(basename "$0" .sh)" "$@")
    argc__positionals=()
    _argc_index=1
    _argc_len="${#argc__args[@]}"
    _argc_required_flag_options=()
    _argc_required_envs=()
    _argc_tools=()
    _argc_parse
    if [ -n "${argc__fn:-}" ]; then
        $argc__fn "${argc__positionals[@]}"
    fi
}
"""

TAKE_ARGS = """_argc_take_args() {
    _argc_take_args_values=()
    _argc_take_args_len=0
    local param="$1" min="$2" max="$3" signs="$4" delimiter="$5"
    if [[ "$min" -eq 0 ]] && [[ "$max" -eq 0 ]]; then
        return
    fi
    local _argc_take_index=$((_argc_index + 1)) _argc_take_value
    if [[ "$_argc_item" == *=* ]]; then
        _argc_take_args_values=("${_argc_item##*=}")
    else
        while [[ $_argc_take_index -lt $_argc_len ]]; do
            _argc_take_value="${argc__args[_argc_take_index]}"
            if _argc_maybe_flag_option "$signs" "$_argc_take_value"; then
                if [[ "${#_argc_take_value}" -gt 1 ]]; then
                    break
                fi
            fi
            _argc_take_args_values+=("$_argc_take_value")
            _argc_take_args_len=$((_argc_take_args_len + 1))
            if [[ "$_argc_take_args_len" -ge "$max" ]]; then
                break
            fi
            _argc_take_index=$((_argc_take_index + 1))
        done
    fi
    if [[ "${#_argc_take_args_values[@]}" -lt "$min" ]]; then
        _argc_die "error: incorrect number of values for \\`$param\\`"
    fi
    if [[ -n "$delimiter" ]] && [[ "${#_argc_take_args_values[@]}" -gt 0 ]]; then

def sanitize(name):
    # Replace :: with _
    return name.replace('::','_')

def format_usage(cmd, full_path):
    # Simplified version from argc_impl
    parts=[]
    parts.append(" ".join(full_path))
    has_optional = any(fo.long_name not in ('--help','--version') and not fo.required for fo in cmd.flag_options)
    has_required = [fo for fo in cmd.flag_options if fo.required and fo.long_name not in ('--help','--version')]
    if has_optional:
        parts.append("[OPTIONS]")
    for fo in has_required:
        if fo.flag:
            parts.append(fo.long_name)
        else:
            if fo.notations:
                parts.append(f"{fo.long_name} <{fo.notations[0]}>")
            else:
                parts.append(fo.long_name)
    for pos in cmd.positionals:
        if pos.required:
            base=f"<{pos.notation}>"
        else:
            base=f"[{pos.notation}]"
        if pos.multiple:
            base=base+"..."
        parts.append(base)
    if cmd.subcommands_list:
        parts.append("<COMMAND>")
    return "USAGE: " + " ".join(parts)

                            pass
            extras=[]
            if fo.choice and fo.choice.get('type')=='Values':
                extras.append(f"[possible values: {', '.join(fo.choice.get('data',[]))}]")
            if fo.default and fo.default.get('type')=='Value':
                extras.append(f"[default: {fo.default.get('value')}]")

            desc = fo.describe

    if cmd.subcommands_list:

            desc = sc.describe.split("\n")[0] if sc.describe else ""
            alias_part = f" [aliases: {', '.join(sc.aliases)}]" if sc.aliases else ""
            default_part = " [default]" if sc.default_subcommand else ""
            if desc:
                lines.append(f"  {sc.name}  {desc}{alias_part}{default_part}")
            else:
                if alias_part or default_part:
                    combined_extra = f"{alias_part}{default_part}".strip()
                    pad_len = 40 - (2 + len(sc.name))
                    if pad_len < 2:
                        pad_len = 2
                    lines.append(f"  {sc.name}{' '*pad_len}{combined_extra}")
                else:
                    lines.append(f"  {sc.name}")
        lines.append("")
    if cmd.envs:

        for env in cmd.envs:
            name_disp = env.id + ("*" if env.required else "")
            extras=[]
            if env.choice and env.choice.get('type')=='Values':

                else:
                    full = " ".join(extras)
            lines.append(f"  {name_disp:<10}{full}")
        lines.append("")
    return "\n".join(lines).strip()

def sanitize(name):
    # Replace :: with _
    return name.replace('::','_')

def format_usage(cmd, full_path):
    # Simplified version from argc_impl
    parts=[]
    parts.append(" ".join(full_path))
    has_optional = any(fo.long_name not in ('--help','--version') and not fo.required for fo in cmd.flag_options)
    has_required = [fo for fo in cmd.flag_options if fo.required and fo.long_name not in ('--help','--version')]
    if has_optional:
        parts.append("[OPTIONS]")
    for fo in has_required:
        if fo.flag:
            parts.append(fo.long_name)
        else:
            if fo.notations:
                parts.append(f"{fo.long_name} <{fo.notations[0]}>")
            else:
                parts.append(fo.long_name)
    for pos in cmd.positionals:
        if pos.required:
            base=f"<{pos.notation}>"
        else:
            base=f"[{pos.notation}]"
        if pos.multiple:
            base=base+"..."
        parts.append(base)
    if cmd.subcommands_list:
        parts.append("<COMMAND>")
    return "USAGE: " + " ".join(parts)

            extras=[]

            if fo.default and fo.default.get('type')=='Value':

            desc = sc.describe.split("\n")[0] if sc.describe else ""
            alias_part = f" [aliases: {', '.join(sc.aliases)}]" if sc.aliases else ""
            default_part = " [default]" if sc.default_subcommand else ""
            if desc:
                lines.append(f"  {sc.name}  {desc}{alias_part}{default_part}")
            else:
                if alias_part or default_part:

                    pad_len = 40 - (2 + len(sc.name))

                    lines.append(f"  {sc.name}{' '*pad_len}{combined_extra}")
                else:
                    lines.append(f"  {sc.name}")
        lines.append("")
    if cmd.envs:
        lines.append("ENVIRONMENTS:")
        for env in cmd.envs:
            name_disp = env.id + ("*" if env.required else "")
            extras=[]
            if env.choice and env.choice.get('type')=='Values':

            if env.default and env.default.get('type')=='Value':

            full = env.describe

                if full:
                    full = full + " " + " ".join(extras)
                else:
                    full = " ".join(extras)
            lines.append(f"  {name_disp:<10}{full}")
        lines.append("")
    return "\n".join(lines).strip()

def generate_man_for_command(cmd, full_path, out_dir):
    # full_path like ["demo"] or ["demo","upload"]
    # name for man page: "-".join(full_path) + ".1" ? For demo upload, name "demo-upload.1"
    # For root, "demo.1"

    # So version for man header: use root version? Actually for subcommand man, they used "demo-download 0.0.0" where version is root's version? For demo root version None -> 0.0.0, subcommand also 0.0.0
    # For version_test with meta version 2.5.1, root man header was "version_test 2.5.1" and subcommand "version_test-cmd1 0.0.0" – subcommand version 0.0.0 not 2.5.1
    # So man header version for subcommand is 0.0.0 unless subcommand has its own version?
    # For simplicity, use 0.0.0 if cmd.version None else cmd.version

    ver = cmd.version if cmd.version else "0.0.0"

    # In example: .TH DEMO 1  "demo 0.0.0"  -> first is upper man_name without .1, second 1, third is "<name> <ver>" where name is full_path with "-" ?

                    extras.append(f"[default: {fo.default.get('value')}]")
                desc = fo.describe
                full_desc = desc + " " + " ".join(extras) if desc else " ".join(extras)
                full_desc = full_desc.strip()
                if full_desc:
                    if len(name_disp) < 30:
                        pad = 30 - len(name_disp)
                        if pad < 2:
                            pad = 2
                        lines.append(f"{name_disp}{' '*pad}{full_desc}")
                    else:
                        lines.append(name_disp)
                        lines.append(f"          {full_desc}")
                else:
                    lines.append(name_disp)
            lines.append("")
        if cmd.subcommands_list:
            lines.append("COMMANDS:")
            for sc in cmd.subcommands_list:
                desc = sc.describe.split("\n")[0] if sc.describe else ""
                alias_str = f" [aliases: {', '.join(sc.aliases)}]" if sc.aliases else ""
                default_str = " [default]" if sc.default_subcommand else ""
                if desc:
                    lines.append(f"  {sc.name}  {desc}{alias_str}{default_str}")
                else:
                    if alias_str or default_str:
                        combined_extra = f"{alias_str}{default_str}".strip()
                        pad_len = 40 - (2 + len(sc.name))
                        if pad_len < 2:
                            pad_len = 2
                        lines.append(f"  {sc.name}{' '*pad_len}{combined_extra}")
                    else:
                        lines.append(f"  {sc.name}")
            lines.append("")
        if cmd.envs:
            lines.append("ENVIRONMENTS:")
            for env in cmd.envs:
                name_disp = env.id + ("*" if env.required else "")
                extras=[]
                if env.choice and env.choice.get('type')=='Values':
                    extras.append(f"[possible values: {', '.join(env.choice.get('data',[]))}]")
                if env.default and env.default.get('type')=='Value':
                    extras.append(f"[default: {env.default.get('value')}]")
                full = env.describe
                if extras:
                    if full:
                        full = full + " " + " ".join(extras)
                    else:
                        full = " ".join(extras)
                lines.append(f"  {name_disp:<10}{full}")
            lines.append("")

    def generate_parse(cmd, full_path, is_root=False):
        sanitized = sanitize("_".join(full_path[1:])) if not is_root else ""
        func_name = "_argc_parse" if is_root else f"_argc_parse_{sanitized}"
        usage_func = "_argc_usage" if is_root else f"_argc_usage_{sanitized}"
        version_func = "_argc_version"
        lines=[]
        lines.append(f"{func_name}() {{")
        lines.append(f"    local _argc_key _argc_action")
        subcmds=[]
        for sc in cmd.subcommands_list:
            subcmds.append(sc.name)
            subcmds.extend(sc.aliases)
        subcmds_str = ", ".join(subcmds)
        lines.append(f'    local _argc_subcmds="{subcmds_str}"')
        lines.append(f"    while [[ $_argc_index -lt $_argc_len ]]; do")
        lines.append(f"        _argc_item=\"${{argc__args[_argc_index]}}\"")
        lines.append(f"        _argc_key=\"${{_argc_item%%=*}}\"")
        lines.append(f"        case \"$_argc_key\" in")
        lines.append(f"        --help | -help | -h)")
        lines.append(f"            {usage_func}")
        lines.append(f"            ;;")
        if is_root:
            lines.append(f"        --version | -version | -V)")
            lines.append(f"            {version_func}")
            lines.append(f"            ;;")
        lines.append(f"        --)")
        lines.append(f"            _argc_dash=\"${{#argc__positionals[@]}}\"")
        lines.append(f"            argc__positionals+=(\"${{argc__args[@]:$((_argc_index + 1))}}\")")
        lines.append(f"            _argc_index=$_argc_len")
        lines.append(f"            break")
        lines.append(f"            ;;")
        for fo in cmd.flag_options:
            if fo.long_name in ('--help','--version'):
                continue
            pats=[]
            if fo.long_name:
                pats.append(fo.long_name)
            if fo.short_name:
                pats.append(fo.short_name)
            if not pats:
                continue
            pat_str = " | ".join(pats)
            lines.append(f"        {pat_str})")
            if fo.flag:
                lines.append(f"            if [[ \"$_argc_item\" == *=* ]]; then")
                lines.append(f"                _argc_die \"error: flag \\`{fo.long_name}\\` don't accept any value\"")
                lines.append(f"            fi")
                lines.append(f"            _argc_index=$((_argc_index + 1))")
                if fo.multiple_occurs:
                    lines.append(f"            if [[ -n \"${{argc_{fo.id}:-}}\" ]]; then")
                    lines.append(f"                argc_{fo.id}=$((argc_{fo.id} + 1))")
                    lines.append(f"            else")
                    lines.append(f"                argc_{fo.id}=1")
                    lines.append(f"            fi")
                else:
                    lines.append(f"            if [[ -n \"${{argc_{fo.id}:-}}\" ]]; then")
                    lines.append(f"                _argc_die \"error: the argument \\`{fo.long_name}\\` cannot be used multiple times\"")
                    lines.append(f"            else")
                    lines.append(f"                argc_{fo.id}=1")
                    lines.append(f"            fi")
                lines.append(f"            ;;")
            else:
                # option
                if fo.notations:
                    param_not = " ".join(f"<{n}>" for n in fo.notations)
                    param = f"{fo.long_name} {param_not}"
                else:
                    param = fo.long_name
                min_a, max_a = fo.num_args
                delim = fo.delimiter if fo.delimiter else ""
                lines.append(f"            _argc_take_args \"{param}\" {min_a} {max_a} \"-\" \"{delim}\"")
                lines.append(f"            _argc_index=$((_argc_index + _argc_take_args_len + 1))")
                if fo.choice:
                    if fo.choice.get('type')=='Values':
                        vals = fo.choice.get('data',[])
                        lines.append(f"            _argc_validate_choices '`<{fo.notations[0]}>`' \"$(printf \"%s\\n\" {' '.join(vals)})\" \"${{_argc_take_args_values[@]}}\"")
                    elif fo.choice.get('type')=='Fn':
                        fn = fo.choice.get('data',[None,True])[0]
                        lines.append(f"            _argc_validate_choices '`<{fo.notations[0]}>`' \"$({fn})\" \"${{_argc_take_args_values[@]}}\"")
                if fo.multiple_occurs or fo.multiple_values or fo.terminated or len(fo.notations)>1 or fo.num_args[1]>=32767:
                    lines.append(f"            argc_{fo.id}+=(\"${{_argc_take_args_values[@]}}\")")
                else:
                    lines.append(f"            if [[ -z \"${{argc_{fo.id}:-}}\" ]]; then")
                    lines.append(f"                argc_{fo.id}=\"${{_argc_take_args_values[0]:-}}\"")
                    lines.append(f"            else")
                    lines.append(f"                _argc_die \"error: the argument \\`{fo.long_name}\\` cannot be used multiple times\"")
                    lines.append(f"            fi")
                lines.append(f"            ;;")
        for sc in cmd.subcommands_list:
            pats = [sc.name] + sc.aliases
            pat_str = " | ".join(pats)
            sanitized_sub = sanitize("_".join((full_path+[sc.name])[1:]))
            lines.append(f"        {pat_str})")
            lines.append(f"            _argc_index=$((_argc_index + 1))")
            lines.append(f"            _argc_action=_argc_parse_{sanitized_sub}")
            lines.append(f"            break")
            lines.append(f"            ;;")
        if cmd.subcommands_list:
            lines.append(f"        help)")
            lines.append(f"            local help_arg=\"${{argc__args[$((_argc_index + 1))]:-}}\"")
            lines.append(f"            case \"$help_arg\" in")
            for sc in cmd.subcommands_list:
                pats = [sc.name] + sc.aliases
                pat_str = " | ".join(pats)
                sanitized_sub = sanitize("_".join((full_path+[sc.name])[1:]))
                lines.append(f"            {pat_str})")
                lines.append(f"                _argc_usage_{sanitized_sub}")
                lines.append(f"                ;;")
            lines.append(f"            \"\")")
            lines.append(f"                {usage_func}")
            lines.append(f"                ;;")
            lines.append(f"            *)")
            lines.append(f"                _argc_die \"error: invalid value \\`$help_arg\\` for \\`<command>\\`\"$'\\n'\"  [possible values: {subcmds_str}]\"")
            lines.append(f"                ;;")
            lines.append(f"            esac")
            lines.append(f"            ;;")
        lines.append(f"        *)")
        default_sc=None
        for sc in cmd.subcommands_list:
            if sc.default_subcommand:

        if cmd.subcommands_list:

                lines.append(f"            if [[ \"${{#argc__positionals[@]}}\" -eq 0 ]]; then")
                lines.append(f"                _argc_action=_argc_parse_{sanitized_default}")
                lines.append(f"                break")
                lines.append(f"            fi")
                lines.append(f"            ;;")
            else:
                if is_root:
                    lines.append(f"            _argc_die \"error: \\`{full_path[0]}\\` requires a subcommand but one was not provided\"$'\\n'\"  [subcommands: {subcmds_str}]\"")
                    lines.append(f"            ;;")
                else:
                    lines.append(f"            if _argc_maybe_flag_option \"-\" \"$_argc_item\"; then")
                    lines.append(f"                _argc_die \"error: unexpected argument \\`$_argc_key\\` found\"")
                    lines.append(f"            fi")
                    lines.append(f"            argc__positionals+=(\"$_argc_item\")")
                    lines.append(f"            _argc_index=$((_argc_index + 1))")
                    lines.append(f"            ;;")
        else:
            lines.append(f"            if _argc_maybe_flag_option \"-\" \"$_argc_item\"; then")
            lines.append(f"                _argc_die \"error: unexpected argument \\`$_argc_key\\` found\"")
            lines.append(f"            fi")
            lines.append(f"            argc__positionals+=(\"$_argc_item\")")
            lines.append(f"            _argc_index=$((_argc_index + 1))")
            lines.append(f"            ;;")
        lines.append(f"        esac")
        lines.append(f"    done")
        # defaults and required
        if not cmd.subcommands_list:
            for fo in cmd.flag_options:
                if fo.long_name in ('--help','--version'):
                    continue
                if fo.default:
                    if fo.default.get('type')=='Value':
                        lines.append(f"    if [[ -z \"${{argc_{fo.id}:-}}\" ]]; then")
                        lines.append(f"        argc_{fo.id}={fo.default.get('value')}")
                        lines.append(f"    fi")
                    elif fo.default.get('type')=='Fn':
                        fn = fo.default.get('value')
                        lines.append(f"    if [[ -z \"${{argc_{fo.id}:-}}\" ]]; then")
                        lines.append(f"        argc_{fo.id}=\"$({fn})\"")
                        lines.append(f"    fi")
            req_list=[]
            for fo in cmd.flag_options:
                if fo.long_name in ('--help','--version'):
                    continue
                if fo.required:
                    if fo.notations:
                        param_disp = f"{fo.long_name} <{fo.notations[0]}>"
                        if fo.multiple_occurs or fo.multiple_values:
                            param_disp = param_disp + "..."
                    else:
                        param_disp = fo.long_name
                    req_list.append(f"'argc_{fo.id}:{param_disp}'")
            if req_list:
                lines.append(f"    _argc_required_flag_options+=({' '.join(req_list)})")

                for pos in cmd.positionals:

                lines.append(f"    _argc_match_positionals {' '.join(pos_params)}")
                lines.append(f"    local values_index values_size")
