            lines.append(f"    if [[ -n \"${{_argc_action:-}}\" ]]; then")
            lines.append(f"        $_argc_action")
            lines.append(f"    else")
            lines.append(f"        {usage_func}")
            lines.append(f"    fi")
        else:
            lines.append(f"    if [[ -n \"${{_argc_action:-}}\" ]]; then")
            lines.append(f"        $_argc_action")
            lines.append(f"    else")
            if cmd.command_fn:
                lines.append(f"        argc__fn={cmd.command_fn}")
                lines.append(f"        if [[ \"${{argc__positionals[0]:-}}\" == \"help\" ]] && [[ \"${{#argc__positionals[@]}}\" -eq 1 ]]; then")
                lines.append(f"            {usage_func}")

    build_parts.append(f"_argc_usage() {{\n    cat <<-'EOF'\n{root_help}\nEOF\n    exit\n}}\n")
    ver = root.version if root.version else "0.0.0"
    build_parts.append(f"_argc_version() {{\n    echo {basename_no_ext} {ver}\n    exit\n}}\n")
    build_parts.append(generate_parse(root, [basename_no_ext], is_root=True))

    def gen_sub_recursive(cmd, path):
        out=""
        for sc in cmd.subcommands_list:
            sc_path = path + [sc.name]
            sc_help = generate_help_for_build(sc, sc_path)
            sanitized = sanitize("_".join(sc_path[1:]))
            out += f"_argc_usage_{sanitized}() {{\n    cat <<-'EOF'\n{sc_help}\nEOF\n    exit\n}}\n\n"
            out += generate_parse(sc, sc_path, is_root=False) + "\n"
            out += gen_sub_recursive(sc, sc_path)

    build_content += f"_argc_usage() {{\n    cat <<-'EOF'\n{generate_help_for_build(root, [basename_no_ext])}\nEOF\n    exit\n}}\n\n"
    build_content += f"_argc_version() {{\n    echo {basename_no_ext} {ver}\n    exit\n}}\n\n"
    build_content += generate_parse(root, [basename_no_ext], is_root=True) + "\n"
    build_content += gen_sub_recursive(root, [basename_no_ext])

    # helpers
    build_content += TAKE_ARGS + "\n"
    build_content += MATCH_POSITIONALS + "\n"
    if any(fo.delimiter or pos.delimiter for cmd,_ in all_cmds for fo in cmd.flag_options for pos in cmd.positionals if False) or True:
        # Check if any delimiter
        has_delim = any(fo.delimiter for cmd,_ in all_cmds for fo in cmd.flag_options) or any(pos.delimiter for cmd,_ in all_cmds for pos in cmd.positionals)
        if has_delim:
            build_content += SPLIT_POSITIONALS + "\n"
    has_choice = any(fo.choice for cmd,_ in all_cmds for fo in cmd.flag_options) or any(pos.choice for cmd,_ in all_cmds for pos in cmd.positionals) or any(env.choice for cmd,_ in all_cmds for env in cmd.envs)
    if has_choice:
        build_content += VALIDATE_CHOICES + "\n"
    build_content += MAYBE_FLAG + "\n"
    if has_dotenv:
        build_content += LOAD_DOTENV + "\n"
    if has_required or has_env_required or has_dotenv:
        build_content += REQUIRE_PARAMS + "\n"
    if has_tools:
        build_content += REQUIRE_TOOLS + "\n"
    build_content += DIE + "\n"
    build_content += '\n_argc_run "$@"\n\n# ARGC-BUILD }\n'

    with open(target, 'w') as out:
        out.write(build_content)
    import os
    os.chmod(target, 0o755)
    print(f"saved {target}")

    if [[ -n "$delimiter" ]] && [[ "${#_argc_take_args_values[@]}" -gt 0 ]]; then
        local item values arr=()
        for item in "${_argc_take_args_values[@]}"; do
            IFS="$delimiter" read -r -a values <<<"$item"
            arr+=("${values[@]}")

        _argc_take_args_values=("${arr[@]}")

}

MATCH_POSITIONALS = """_argc_match_positionals() {
    _argc_match_positionals_values=()
    _argc_match_positionals_len=0
    local params=("$@")
    local args_len="${#argc__positionals[@]}"
    if [[ $args_len -eq 0 ]]; then
        return
    fi
    local params_len=$# arg_index=0 param_index=0
    while [[ $param_index -lt $params_len && $arg_index -lt $args_len ]]; do
        local takes=0
        if [[ "${params[param_index]}" -eq 1 ]]; then
            if [[ $param_index -eq 0 ]] &&
                [[ ${_argc_dash:-} -gt 0 ]] &&
                [[ $params_len -eq 2 ]] &&
                [[ "${params[$((param_index + 1))]}" -eq 1 ]] \\
                ; then
                takes=${_argc_dash:-}
            else
                local arg_diff=$((args_len - arg_index)) param_diff=$((params_len - param_index))
                if [[ $arg_diff -gt $param_diff ]]; then
                    takes=$((arg_diff - param_diff + 1))
                else
                    takes=1
                fi
            fi
        else
            takes=1
        fi
        _argc_match_positionals_values+=("$arg_index:$takes")
        arg_index=$((arg_index + takes))
        param_index=$((param_index + 1))
    done
    if [[ $arg_index -lt $args_len ]]; then
        _argc_match_positionals_values+=("$arg_index:$((args_len - arg_index))")
    fi
    _argc_match_positionals_len=${#_argc_match_positionals_values[@]}
    if [[ $params_len -gt 0 ]] && [[ $_argc_match_positionals_len -gt $params_len ]]; then
        local index="${_argc_match_positionals_values[params_len]%%:*}"
        _argc_die "error: unexpected argument \\`${argc__positionals[index]}\\` found"
    fi

SPLIT_POSITIONALS = """_argc_split_positionals() {
    _argc_split_positionals_values=()
    local values_index="$1" values_size="$2" delimiter="$3" item values
    local split_values=("${argc__positionals[@]:values_index:values_size}")
    for item in "${split_values[@]}"; do
        IFS="$delimiter" read -r -a values <<<"$item"
        _argc_split_positionals_values+=("${values[@]}")
    done
    local heads=() tails=() tails_index=$((values_index + values_size))
    if [[ $values_index -gt 0 ]]; then
        heads=("${argc__positionals[@]:0:values_index}")
    fi
    if [[ $tails_index -lt ${#argc__positionals[@]} ]]; then
        tails=("${argc__positionals[@]:tails_index}")
    fi
    argc__positionals=("${heads[@]}" "${_argc_split_positionals_values[@]}" "${tails[@]}")
}
"""

VALIDATE_CHOICES = """_argc_validate_choices() {
    local render_name="$1" raw_choices="$2" choices item choice concated_choices=""
    while IFS= read -r line; do
        choices+=("$line")
    done <<<"$raw_choices"
    for choice in "${choices[@]}"; do
        if [[ -z "$concated_choices" ]]; then
            concated_choices="$choice"
        else
            concated_choices="$concated_choices, $choice"
        fi
    done
    for item in "${@:3}"; do
        local pass=0 choice
        for choice in "${choices[@]}"; do
            if [[ "$item" == "$choice" ]]; then
                pass=1
            fi
        done
        if [[ $pass -ne 1 ]]; then
            _argc_die "error: invalid value \\`$item\\` for $render_name"$'\\n'"  [possible values: $concated_choices]"
        fi
    done
}
"""

MAYBE_FLAG = """_argc_maybe_flag_option() {
    local signs="$1" arg="$2"
    if [[ -z "$signs" ]]; then
        return 1
    fi
    local cond=false
    if [[ "$signs" == *"+"* ]]; then
        if [[ "$arg" =~ ^\\+[^+].* ]]; then
            cond=true
        fi
    elif [[ "$arg" == -* ]]; then
        if (( ${#arg} < 3 )) || [[ ! "$arg" =~ ^---.* ]]; then
            cond=true
        fi
    fi
    if [[ "$cond" == "false" ]]; then
        return 1
    fi
    local value="${arg%%=*}"
    if [[ "$value" =~ [[:space:]] ]]; then
        return 1
    fi
    return 0
}
"""

DIE = """_argc_die() {
    if [[ $# -eq 0 ]]; then
        cat
    else
        echo "$*" >&2
    fi
    exit 1
}
"""

LOAD_DOTENV = """_argc_load_dotenv() {
    local env_file="$1" env_vars=""
    if [[ -f "$env_file" ]]; then
        while IFS='=' read -r key value; do
            if [[ "$key" == $'#'* ]] || [[ -z "$key" ]]; then
                continue
            fi
            if [[ -z "${!key+x}" ]]; then
                env_vars="$env_vars $key=$value"
            fi
        done < <(cat "$env_file"; echo "")
        if [[ -n "$env_vars" ]]; then
            eval "export $env_vars"
        fi
    fi
}
"""

REQUIRE_PARAMS = """_argc_require_params() {
    local message="$1" missed_envs="" item name render_name
    for item in "${@:2}"; do
        name="${item%%:*}"
        render_name="${item##*:}"
        if [[ -z "${!name:-}" ]]; then
            missed_envs="$missed_envs"$'\\n'"  $render_name"
        fi
    done
    if [[ -n "${missed_envs}" ]]; then
        _argc_die "$message$missed_envs"
    fi

REQUIRE_TOOLS = """_argc_require_tools() {
    local tool missing_tools=()
    for tool in "$@"; do

            missing_tools+=("$tool")
        fi
    done
    if [[ "${#missing_tools[@]}" -gt 0 ]]; then
        echo "error: missing tools: ${missing_tools[*]}" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
}

def sanitize(name):
    return name.replace('::','_')

def generate_build(file_path, out_dir=None):
    import pathlib, os
    root, funcs = parse_file(file_path)

    with open(file_path, 'r', encoding='utf-8', errors='ignore') as f:
        orig_content = f.read()
    orig_lines = orig_content.splitlines()
    filtered_lines = [l for l in orig_lines if 'argc --argc-eval' not in l]

    basename = os.path.basename(file_path)
    if basename.endswith('.sh'):
        basename_no_ext = basename[:-3]
    else:
        basename_no_ext = basename

    # Determine target
    if out_dir:
        out_path = pathlib.Path(out_dir)
        if out_path.exists() and out_path.is_dir():
            target = out_path / basename
        elif str(out_path).endswith('.sh'):
            target = out_path
        else:
            out_path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            target = out_path / basename
    else:
        build_dir = pathlib.Path("build")
        build_dir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        target = build_dir / basename

    # Collect all commands
    def collect_commands(cmd, path, out_list):
        out_list.append((cmd, path))
        for sc in cmd.subcommands_list:
            collect_commands(sc, path+[sc.name], out_list)

    all_cmds = []
    collect_commands(root, [basename_no_ext], all_cmds)

    # Generate help for each command using mangen's help generation? We'll reuse simple help but need to generate usage similar to original build

    # For build, we need to generate _argc_usage and _argc_parse for each

    # Let's generate using functions similar to earlier attempt but simplified

    build_parts = []
    # _argc_run - choose simple or with require checks
    has_required = any(fo.required for cmd,_ in all_cmds for fo in cmd.flag_options if fo.long_name not in ('--help','--version'))
    has_env_required = any(env.required for cmd,_ in all_cmds for env in cmd.envs)
    has_dotenv = any(cmd.dotenv for cmd,_ in all_cmds)
    has_tools = any(cmd.require_tools for cmd,_ in all_cmds)

    if has_required or has_env_required or has_dotenv or has_tools:
        # Use version with require checks
        run_code = """_argc_run() {
    if [[ "${1:-}" == "___internal___" ]]; then
        _argc_die "error: unsupported ___internal___ command"
    fi
    if [[ "${OS:-}" == "Windows_NT" ]] && [[ -n "${MSYSTEM:-}" ]]; then
        set -o igncr
    fi
    argc__args=("$(basename "$0" .sh)" "$@")
    argc__positionals=()
    _argc_index=1
    _argc_len="${#argc__args[@]}"
    _argc_required_flag_options=()
    _argc_required_envs=()
    _argc_tools=()
"""
        if has_dotenv:
            # need dotenv path: use first dotenv found
            dotenv_path = ".env"
            for cmd,_ in all_cmds:
                if cmd.dotenv:
                    dotenv_path = cmd.dotenv
                    break
            run_code += f"    _argc_load_dotenv {dotenv_path}\n"
        run_code += """    _argc_parse
"""
        if has_required or has_env_required:
            if has_required and has_env_required:
                run_code += """    _argc_require_params "error: the following required arguments were not provided:" "${_argc_required_flag_options[@]}"
    _argc_require_params "error: the following required environments were not provided:" "${_argc_required_envs[@]}"
"""
            elif has_required:
                run_code += """    _argc_require_params "error: the following required arguments were not provided:" "${_argc_required_flag_options[@]}"
"""
            else:
                run_code += """    _argc_require_params "error: the following required environments were not provided:" "${_argc_required_envs[@]}"
"""
        if has_tools:
            run_code += """    if [[ -n "${_argc_tools:-}" ]]; then
        _argc_require_tools "${_argc_tools[@]}"
    fi
"""
        run_code += """    if [ -n "${argc__fn:-}" ]; then
        $argc__fn "${argc__positionals[@]}"
    fi
}
"""
        build_parts.append(run_code)
    else:
        build_parts.append(ARGC_RUN_SIMPLE)

    # Generate usage and parse for each command

    def format_usage_for_build(cmd, full_path):
        parts=[]
        parts.append(" ".join(full_path))
        has_optional = any(fo.long_name not in ('--help','--version') and not fo.required for fo in cmd.flag_options)
        has_required = [fo for fo in cmd.flag_options if fo.required and fo.long_name not in ('--help','--version')]
        if has_optional:
            parts.append("[OPTIONS]")
        for fo in has_required:
            if fo.flag:
                parts.append(fo.long_name)
            else:
                if fo.notations:
                    # handle multi
                    if len(fo.notations)==1:
                        if fo.multiple_occurs:
                            parts.append(f"{fo.long_name} <{fo.notations[0]}>...")
                        else:
                            parts.append(f"{fo.long_name} <{fo.notations[0]}>")
                    else:
                        parts.append(f"{fo.long_name} " + " ".join(f"<{n}>" for n in fo.notations))
                else:
                    parts.append(fo.long_name)
        for pos in cmd.positionals:
            if pos.required:
                base=f"<{pos.notation}>"
            else:
                base=f"[{pos.notation}]"
            if pos.multiple:
                base=base+"..."
            parts.append(base)
        if cmd.subcommands_list:
            parts.append("<COMMAND>")
        return "USAGE: " + " ".join(parts)

    def generate_help_for_build(cmd, full_path):
        # Use generate_help_for_cmd from mangen if available, else simple
        try:
            from mangen import generate_man_for_command
            # Not exactly help, but we want help text similar to earlier generate_help_simple
            # We'll use a simple version
            pass
        except:
            pass
        # For build, we need help text that matches original's _argc_usage
        # We'll generate using a simplified version that at least includes description and usage and subcommands

        lines=[]
        if cmd.describe:
            lines.append(cmd.describe)
            lines.append("")
        lines.append(format_usage_for_build(cmd, full_path))
        lines.append("")
        if cmd.positionals:
            lines.append("ARGS:")
            for pos in cmd.positionals:
                if pos.required:
                    base=f"<{pos.notation}>"
                else:
                    base=f"[{pos.notation}]"
                if pos.multiple:
                    base=base+"..."
                lines.append(f"  {base}  {pos.describe}")
            lines.append("")
        if any(fo.long_name not in ('--help','--version') for fo in cmd.flag_options):
            lines.append("OPTIONS:")
            for fo in cmd.flag_options:
                if fo.short_name and fo.long_name:
                    name_disp = f"{fo.short_name}, {fo.long_name}"
                elif fo.long_name:
                    if fo.long_name.startswith('--'):
                        name_disp = f"      {fo.long_name}"
                    else:
                        name_disp = f"  {fo.long_name}"
                else:
                    name_disp = f"  {fo.short_name}"
                if not fo.flag and fo.notations:
                    if fo.assigned:
                        name_disp = name_disp + f"=<{fo.notations[0]}>"
                    else:
                        if len(fo.notations)==1:
                            name_disp = name_disp + f" <{fo.notations[0]}>"
                        else:
                            name_disp = name_disp + " " + " ".join(f"<{n}>" for n in fo.notations)
                    if fo.multiple_occurs and not (fo.notations[0].endswith('*') or fo.notations[0].endswith('+') or fo.notations[0].endswith('?') or fo.notations[0].endswith('~')):
                        if fo.required:
                            pass
                        else:
                            # convert <> to [] for optional multi?
                            # For simplicity keep
                            pass
                if fo.flag and fo.multiple_occurs:
                    name_disp = name_disp + "..."
                extras=[]
                if fo.choice and fo.choice.get('type')=='Values':
                    extras.append(f"[possible values: {', '.join(fo.choice.get('data',[]))}]")
                if fo.default and fo.default.get('type')=='Value':
                    extras.append(f"[default: {fo.default.get('value')}]")
                desc = fo.describe
                full_desc = desc + " " + " ".join(extras) if desc else " ".join(extras)
                full_desc = full_desc.strip()
                if full_desc:
                    if len(name_disp) < 30:
                        pad = 30 - len(name_disp)
                        if pad < 2:
                            pad = 2
                        lines.append(f"{name_disp}{' '*pad}{full_desc}")
                    else:
                        lines.append(name_disp)
                        lines.append(f"          {full_desc}")
                else:
                    lines.append(name_disp)
            lines.append("")
        if cmd.subcommands_list:
            lines.append("COMMANDS:")
            for sc in cmd.subcommands_list:
                desc = sc.describe.split("\n")[0] if sc.describe else ""
                alias_str = f" [aliases: {', '.join(sc.aliases)}]" if sc.aliases else ""
                default_str = " [default]" if sc.default_subcommand else ""
                if desc:
                    lines.append(f"  {sc.name}  {desc}{alias_str}{default_str}")
                else:
                    if alias_str or default_str:
                        combined_extra = f"{alias_str}{default_str}".strip()
                        pad_len = 40 - (2 + len(sc.name))
                        if pad_len < 2:
                            pad_len = 2
                        lines.append(f"  {sc.name}{' '*pad_len}{combined_extra}")
                    else:
                        lines.append(f"  {sc.name}")
            lines.append("")
        if cmd.envs:
            lines.append("ENVIRONMENTS:")
            for env in cmd.envs:
                name_disp = env.id + ("*" if env.required else "")
                extras=[]
                if env.choice and env.choice.get('type')=='Values':
                    extras.append(f"[possible values: {', '.join(env.choice.get('data',[]))}]")
                if env.default and env.default.get('type')=='Value':
                    extras.append(f"[default: {env.default.get('value')}]")
                full = env.describe
                if extras:
                    if full:
                        full = full + " " + " ".join(extras)
                    else:
                        full = " ".join(extras)
                lines.append(f"  {name_disp:<10}{full}")
            lines.append("")
        return "\n".join(lines).strip()

    def generate_parse(cmd, full_path, is_root=False):
        sanitized = sanitize("_".join(full_path[1:])) if not is_root else ""
        func_name = "_argc_parse" if is_root else f"_argc_parse_{sanitized}"
        usage_func = "_argc_usage" if is_root else f"_argc_usage_{sanitized}"
        version_func = "_argc_version"
        lines=[]
        lines.append(f"{func_name}() {{")
        lines.append(f"    local _argc_key _argc_action")
        subcmds=[]
        for sc in cmd.subcommands_list:
            subcmds.append(sc.name)
            subcmds.extend(sc.aliases)
        subcmds_str = ", ".join(subcmds)
        lines.append(f'    local _argc_subcmds="{subcmds_str}"')
        lines.append(f"    while [[ $_argc_index -lt $_argc_len ]]; do")
        lines.append(f"        _argc_item=\"${{argc__args[_argc_index]}}\"")
        lines.append(f"        _argc_key=\"${{_argc_item%%=*}}\"")
        lines.append(f"        case \"$_argc_key\" in")
        lines.append(f"        --help | -help | -h)")
        lines.append(f"            {usage_func}")
        lines.append(f"            ;;")
        if is_root:
            lines.append(f"        --version | -version | -V)")
            lines.append(f"            {version_func}")
            lines.append(f"            ;;")
        lines.append(f"        --)")
        lines.append(f"            _argc_dash=\"${{#argc__positionals[@]}}\"")
        lines.append(f"            argc__positionals+=(\"${{argc__args[@]:$((_argc_index + 1))}}\")")
        lines.append(f"            _argc_index=$_argc_len")
        lines.append(f"            break")
        lines.append(f"            ;;")
        for fo in cmd.flag_options:
            if fo.long_name in ('--help','--version'):
                continue
            pats=[]
            if fo.long_name:
                pats.append(fo.long_name)
            if fo.short_name:
                pats.append(fo.short_name)
            if not pats:
                continue
            pat_str = " | ".join(pats)
            lines.append(f"        {pat_str})")
            if fo.flag:
                lines.append(f"            if [[ \"$_argc_item\" == *=* ]]; then")
                lines.append(f"                _argc_die \"error: flag \\`{fo.long_name}\\` don't accept any value\"")
                lines.append(f"            fi")
                lines.append(f"            _argc_index=$((_argc_index + 1))")
                if fo.multiple_occurs:
                    lines.append(f"            if [[ -n \"${{argc_{fo.id}:-}}\" ]]; then")
                    lines.append(f"                argc_{fo.id}=$((argc_{fo.id} + 1))")
                    lines.append(f"            else")
                    lines.append(f"                argc_{fo.id}=1")
                    lines.append(f"            fi")
                else:
                    lines.append(f"            if [[ -n \"${{argc_{fo.id}:-}}\" ]]; then")
                    lines.append(f"                _argc_die \"error: the argument \\`{fo.long_name}\\` cannot be used multiple times\"")
                    lines.append(f"            else")
                    lines.append(f"                argc_{fo.id}=1")
                    lines.append(f"            fi")
                lines.append(f"            ;;")
            else:
                # option
                if fo.notations:
                    param_not = " ".join(f"<{n}>" for n in fo.notations)
                    param = f"{fo.long_name} {param_not}"
                else:
                    param = fo.long_name
                min_a, max_a = fo.num_args
                delim = fo.delimiter if fo.delimiter else ""
                lines.append(f"            _argc_take_args \"{param}\" {min_a} {max_a} \"-\" \"{delim}\"")
                lines.append(f"            _argc_index=$((_argc_index + _argc_take_args_len + 1))")
                if fo.choice:
                    if fo.choice.get('type')=='Values':
                        vals = fo.choice.get('data',[])
                        lines.append(f"            _argc_validate_choices '`<{fo.notations[0]}>`' \"$(printf \"%s\\n\" {' '.join(vals)})\" \"${{_argc_take_args_values[@]}}\"")
                    elif fo.choice.get('type')=='Fn':
                        fn = fo.choice.get('data',[None,True])[0]
                        lines.append(f"            _argc_validate_choices '`<{fo.notations[0]}>`' \"$({fn})\" \"${{_argc_take_args_values[@]}}\"")
                if fo.multiple_occurs or fo.multiple_values or fo.terminated or len(fo.notations)>1 or fo.num_args[1]>=32767:
                    lines.append(f"            argc_{fo.id}+=(\"${{_argc_take_args_values[@]}}\")")
                else:
                    lines.append(f"            if [[ -z \"${{argc_{fo.id}:-}}\" ]]; then")
                    lines.append(f"                argc_{fo.id}=\"${{_argc_take_args_values[0]:-}}\"")
                    lines.append(f"            else")
                    lines.append(f"                _argc_die \"error: the argument \\`{fo.long_name}\\` cannot be used multiple times\"")
                    lines.append(f"            fi")
                lines.append(f"            ;;")
        for sc in cmd.subcommands_list:
            pats = [sc.name] + sc.aliases
            pat_str = " | ".join(pats)
            sanitized_sub = sanitize("_".join((full_path+[sc.name])[1:]))
            lines.append(f"        {pat_str})")
            lines.append(f"            _argc_index=$((_argc_index + 1))")
            lines.append(f"            _argc_action=_argc_parse_{sanitized_sub}")
            lines.append(f"            break")
            lines.append(f"            ;;")
        if cmd.subcommands_list:
            lines.append(f"        help)")
            lines.append(f"            local help_arg=\"${{argc__args[$((_argc_index + 1))]:-}}\"")
            lines.append(f"            case \"$help_arg\" in")
            for sc in cmd.subcommands_list:
                pats = [sc.name] + sc.aliases
                pat_str = " | ".join(pats)
                sanitized_sub = sanitize("_".join((full_path+[sc.name])[1:]))
                lines.append(f"            {pat_str})")
                lines.append(f"                _argc_usage_{sanitized_sub}")
                lines.append(f"                ;;")
            lines.append(f"            \"\")")
            lines.append(f"                {usage_func}")
            lines.append(f"                ;;")
            lines.append(f"            *)")
            lines.append(f"                _argc_die \"error: invalid value \\`$help_arg\\` for \\`<command>\\`\"$'\\n'\"  [possible values: {subcmds_str}]\"")
            lines.append(f"                ;;")
            lines.append(f"            esac")
            lines.append(f"            ;;")
        lines.append(f"        *)")
        default_sc=None
        for sc in cmd.subcommands_list:
            if sc.default_subcommand:
                default_sc=sc
                break
        if cmd.subcommands_list:
            if default_sc:
                sanitized_default = sanitize("_".join((full_path+[default_sc.name])[1:]))
                lines.append(f"            if [[ \"${{#argc__positionals[@]}}\" -eq 0 ]]; then")
                lines.append(f"                _argc_action=_argc_parse_{sanitized_default}")
                lines.append(f"                break")
                lines.append(f"            fi")
                lines.append(f"            ;;")
            else:
                if is_root:
                    lines.append(f"            _argc_die \"error: \\`{full_path[0]}\\` requires a subcommand but one was not provided\"$'\\n'\"  [subcommands: {subcmds_str}]\"")
                    lines.append(f"            ;;")
                else:
                    lines.append(f"            if _argc_maybe_flag_option \"-\" \"$_argc_item\"; then")
                    lines.append(f"                _argc_die \"error: unexpected argument \\`$_argc_key\\` found\"")
                    lines.append(f"            fi")
                    lines.append(f"            argc__positionals+=(\"$_argc_item\")")
                    lines.append(f"            _argc_index=$((_argc_index + 1))")
                    lines.append(f"            ;;")
        else:
            lines.append(f"            if _argc_maybe_flag_option \"-\" \"$_argc_item\"; then")

# _argc_load_dotenv() { ... }
# _argc_load_dotenv .env
# export TEST_EDA=a
# export TEST_EDB=`_default_fn`
# export TEST_ECB=a

python3 <<'PY'
import pathlib
text=pathlib.Path('src/argc_impl.py').read_text()

# Find the section where we build assignments and then output
old = """    all_vals={**flag_vals, **final_pos_assign}
    assignments=[]"""

new = """    # dotenv handling
    dotenv_needed = False
    dotenv_path = ".env"
    if root.dotenv:
        dotenv_needed=True
        dotenv_path=root.dotenv
    if current.dotenv:
        dotenv_needed=True
        dotenv_path=current.dotenv

    # require_tools
    require_tools = []
    require_tools.extend(root.require_tools)
    require_tools.extend(current.require_tools)

    has_before = '_argc_before' in funcs
    has_after = '_argc_after' in funcs

    all_vals={**flag_vals, **final_pos_assign}
    assignments=[]"""

text=text.replace(old,new)

# Now after building assignments, we need to output dotenv loader and env defaults etc before assignments? In original eval, the loader and exports appear before argc__args etc, but after ARGC_VARS? Let's check original order for envs:

# export ARGC_VARS=...
# _argc_load_dotenv() { ... }
# _argc_load_dotenv .env
# export TEST_EDA=a
# export TEST_EDB=`_default_fn`
# export TEST_ECB=a
# argc__args=...
# argc__fn=main
# ...

# So order: ARGC_VARS export first, then loader function, then loader call, then env default exports, then argc assignments.

# Our current code outputs ARGC_VARS then assignments (which include argc__args etc). We need to insert loader and env exports between.

# Let's find where we print assignments and insert

old_print = """    vars_str=";".join(assignments)+";"
    b64=base64.b64encode(vars_str.encode()).decode()
    print(f"export ARGC_VARS={b64}")
    for a in assignments:
        print(a)"""

new_print = """    # For envs with defaults, need to generate additional export lines for env defaults
    extra_env_exports=[]
    for env in current.envs:
        # If env var not set in os.environ and has default Value, export default
        # If default Fn, export with backtick call
        import os
        env_set = os.environ.get(env.id)
        if env_set is None:
            if env.default:
                if env.default.get('type')=='Value':
                    extra_env_exports.append(f"export {env.id}={env.default.get('value')}")
                elif env.default.get('type')=='Fn':
                    fn=env.default.get('value')
                    extra_env_exports.append(f"export {env.id}=`{fn}`")

    # Build assignments for ARGC_VARS includes only argc_ variables, not extra env exports? In original, ARGC_VARS only contained argc_ vars, not env exports. So vars_str should be from assignments only (argc_ vars)

    vars_str=";".join(assignments)+";"
    b64=base64.b64encode(vars_str.encode()).decode()
    print(f"export ARGC_VARS={b64}")

    # Output dotenv loader if needed
    if dotenv_needed:
        print(\"\"\"_argc_load_dotenv() {
    local env_file="$1" env_vars=""

        while IFS='=' read -r key value; do
            if [[ "$key" == $'#'* ]] || [[ -z "$key" ]]; then
                continue
            fi
            if [[ -z "${!key+x}" ]]; then
                env_vars="$env_vars $key=$value"
            fi
        done < <(cat "$env_file"; echo "")
        if [[ -n "$env_vars" ]]; then
            eval "export $env_vars"
        fi
    fi
}
_argc_load_dotenv .env\"\"\")

    # Output extra env exports
    for ee in extra_env_exports:
        print(ee)

    for a in assignments:
        print(a)"""
